mentions.heading: Economic declines reducing automotive sales and production
mentions.detail: 2025 global production +4% (Aptiv-weighted +1%); China +10%, North America -2%, Europe -1%; could force plant shutdowns, impairments
mentions.quote: Global automotive vehicle production increased 4% from 2024 to 2025 (1% on an Aptiv weighted market basis, which represents global vehicle production weighted to the geographic regions in which the Company generates its revenue), reflecting increased vehicle production of 10% in China and 1% in South America, our smallest region, partially offset by declines of 2% in North America and 1% in Europe.

mentions.heading: OEM inventory and production level fluctuations
mentions.detail: Sales depend on unpredictable OEM inventory and production level decisions
mentions.quote: Our sales are also affected by inventory levels and OEMs’ production levels. We cannot predict when OEMs will decide to increase or decrease inventory levels or whether new inventory levels will approximate historical inventory levels.

mentions.heading: Downturn could require additional financing that may not be available
mentions.detail: Prolonged auto downturn or credit market instability may require external financing on unfavorable terms
mentions.quote: Any significant negative cash flow or instability in the global credit markets and global economic pressure could limit our ability to obtain external financing on favorable terms. There can be no assurance that we would be able to secure such financing on terms acceptable to us, or at all.

mentions.heading: Impairment charges from deteriorating conditions and market capitalization
mentions.risk_name: Asset impairment and tax valuation charges
mentions.detail: Downturn could cause plant shutdowns, impairments, restructuring, deferred tax valuation allowance changes
mentions.quote: Any such adverse impacts could require us to shut down plants or result in impairment charges, restructuring actions or changes in our valuation allowances against deferred tax assets, which could be material to our financial condition and results of operations.

mentions.heading: A drop in the market share and changes in product mix offered by our customers can impact our revenues.
mentions.detail: Dependent on automotive OEM customers; loss if demand shifts to models without Aptiv supply contracts
mentions.quote: For instance, a shift in sales demand favoring a particular OEMs’ vehicle model for which we do not have a supply contract may negatively impact our revenue.

mentions.heading: OEM delays in electrification strategies
mentions.detail: High voltage electrification a key market; OEMs delaying software-defined vehicle investment amid weaker demand
mentions.quote: For example, while we have identified high voltage electrification systems as a key product market, certain of our OEM customers have recently announced delays in or changes to their software-defined vehicle investment strategies amidst reduced expectations for future consumer demand for these products, which could adversely impact the growth of this product market within our business.
